snippet.title: Serious Sam Alpha {Remake v1.5 by Zdzichu} - TFE - 01 Hatsheput - No Commentary Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Serious Sam Alpha Remake is a mod created by Zdzichu for Serious Sam The First Encounter. The current version of the mod I am playing on is Version 1.5. 


What I'm doing now is pretty cursed:p. I'm playing the original TFE campaign. Let's hope this works.


Level: Hatsheput
Mod: Serious Sam Alpha Mod (by Zdzichu)
Campaign: Serious Sam TFE campaign*
Performance: Laggy (Turn off lens flares to fix)
Download: https://mega.nz/?fbclid=IwAR0f2YXW-oZkJN34kqV97wJJ7mBq_8bpcNxetz9o_lE0dg_DMLml0a8GyVM#F!px8nXCjC!3GpPCcfzNQpBcHruGcAotg


I found this alpha remake particularly interesting since it implemented a lot of the 'scrapped' abilities which never really were included yet in the actual 'Serious Sam Alpha - Early Build' copy. This includes things such as Gnaar's which spit their projectiles, scrapped animations, or deleted weapons. It is notable that not 'all' enemies from the original 'alpha' series were updated or included.


However it is to be noted that a lot of the behavior ingame seems to really differ in both gameplay from the original TFE and the actual alpha build. Watch me as I struggle to get used to the new timing of all enemies + weapons as they all work differently in this mod. 


*Serious Sam TFE maps which I am playing appears to be directly ported from the original First Encounter campaign and do not have many changes.
